{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Cast {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill damage leaves enemies Magnetized for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, causing them to emit {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} and receive {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased {c_important}Shock{/c} damage from you. 

{u}{c_important}Crackling Energy's{/c}{/u} damage Pulls Magnetized enemies together.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
